message:
Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
xml='''<!DOCTYPE r [
<!ELEMENT r (a,b)>
<!ELEMENT a EMPTY>
<!ELEMENT b EMPTY>
<!ATTLIST a ref IDREF #IMPLIED>
<!ATTLIST b id ID #IMPLIED>
]>
<r><a ref="x"/><b id="x"/></r>
'''
data=(16).to_bytes(4,'little')+b'main\\\n'+xml.encode()+b'\\\n'
Path('poc1.bin').write_bytes(data)
print(len(data), data[:40])
PY
xxd -g1 -l 120 poc1.bin
